title: The verdict is for journalist Yoga Pratama
paragraphs: The verdict for defamation against reporters in Info Sumatra, Yoga Pratama, has been read. The result is that the defendant has been released.
According to the charges, Yoga Pratama published a report about the waste of the palm oil plant on July 25th, 2025 which the prosecutor judged attacked the honor of an official.
The Court of Justice of the Field Court reads the verdict on March 26, 2026.
In the case of Yoga Pratama, Maya Kartika's legal power said the defense request for the judge to be replaced was rejected by the assembly.
Yoga Pratama works as a reporter for Info Sumatra in the Medan, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The prosecutor and the defendant can still appeal.
